title: Bounded cross-provider pilot of unsupported modeling choices
purpose: Describe choice convergence and disagreement under two fixed evidence packets; do not estimate general generation superiority or clinical validity.

design.unit: One provider-family/model/runtime in one fresh context on one fixed case packet; not an independent clinical replication.

provider_families.access: existing authorized wang Chrome web account only; unverified
provider_families.selection_rule: Three distinct provider/developer families, not three aliases or reasoning modes from one family. Freeze selection before any pilot output.

PNS.role: custodian staging anchor: extract only task schema/population and purpose/analyses; replace historical budgets in new visible overlay

LIPID.role: existing requested analyses/schema/units; strip historical diagnostic execution directions if present

PNS.status: not_staged; deterministic source-only assembly and leakage review required

LIPID.status: not_staged; deterministic source-only assembly and leakage review required

information_policy.closed_retrieval_reason: Experimental control for this pilot, not a general limitation on the generation method.
information_policy.historical_target_exposure: Both case families and endpoints are exposed at project level; development only, even with fresh author contexts.
information_policy.author_target_memory: No empirical target estimates are supplied; prior model training or unobservable service memory cannot be excluded.

measurements.primary: Initial declared scientific choices before repair feedback, categorized by structural family, statistical operator, parameter value and provenance/dependencies.
PNS_dimensions: conditional innovation dependence if explicitly defined
LIPID_dimensions: raw/log/rank scale and copula or other joint family
measurements.numeric_comparison: Only identical declared operators/conditioning/scales after valid unit conversion. Show values, range, median absolute deviation and within-family pair differences; otherwise mark not comparable. No forced common rho/tail parameter.
measurements.categorical_comparison: Show all six per case, per-family two-context concordance and modal counts with explicit denominator. A shared pattern is descriptive, not a calibrated convergence claim.
measurements.unavailable: Absent, unidentifiable, omitted and failed records remain distinct; no zero imputation or selective exclusion.

budget.allowed_repair: Missing files/schema/ABI or definite code-spec inconsistency only; no requested sign, target-fit advice or new numerical assumptions. Preserve original choices and all changes.
budget.technical_retry_policy: No automatic resend or regeneration. An interrupted attempt is captured and consumes the slot; only one logged non-scientific continuation within the second-turn budget.
budget.token_matching: Not claimed in browser UI; record actual usage if available, otherwise null plus reason. Equal prompts/turn/time rules do not equalize compute.

deliverables: verbatim prompt and response transcripts with hashes
generator.py using generate(observed,spec,seed), observed=None, and the existing case schema
short decision/evidence table identifying unreported choices and uncertainty
capture receipt and all failure/repair records

execution_later.current_authorization: No construction or execution in this protocol-only unit.
execution_later.minimum_generator_requirement: A prose-only or spec-only submission contributes at most a declared-choice observation, never executable-model evidence.
execution_later.future_smoke: After all initial choices are captured and final code/specs frozen, at most one schema-only run per construction in existing approved WSL/bubblewrap worker, using seed 31001 and task n_rows=3000. No source/clinical estimator, target lookup, seed selection or quality optimization. Preserve pass/fail receipts; do not display generated rows in report.
execution_later.unavailable_worker: Mark executable status unverified; do not use unrestricted local import/run fallback.

launcher_capture.proposal: Existing wang Chrome browser sessions, operated manually or by already available computer-use tools; new chat per slot and provider. No new API client, account, dependency or automation.
launcher_capture.new_receipt_directory_pattern: pilot_capture/<slot_id>/ (created only at later authorized execution)
required_receipt_fields: exact model/snapshot if exposed; else null and reason
fresh-context and memory settings with unverifiable limitations
input file names and UI acceptance/readability evidence
verbatim initial and repair responses with hashes
actual response usage if visible; else null
known_gaps: No current authentication or availability check for three provider families performed.
Existing PNS wrapper has no cross-provider model client and fresh subagents inherit the host model; it is not this launcher.
Exact web model snapshot, hidden system prompts and compute budget may be unavailable.
Common final text payload and receipt files are not staged; final hashes must be frozen before launch.
No existing general cross-provider capture launcher was demonstrated; browser/manual capture is the proposed bounded route, not implemented automation.
Existing frozen PNS/other controllers must not be reused in place or have slots/budgets altered.

prelaunch: Three distinct provider families with existing non-new-paid access verified and metadata frozen before outputs
Identical per-case payload readability and complete delivery verified without extra scientific feedback
Independent target-leakage check and final prompt/packet hashes frozen
Capture, failure and two-turn budget rules agreed and staged without modifying historical studies
Existing approved runtime available if executable status will be claimed
operational_gates.completion: Account for all 12 slots, all initial responses and all repairs/failures; no favorable replacements.
operational_gates.go_for_larger_choice_study: At least 10/12 complete parseable specifications with code/spec traceability and schema-only executable receipts, and at least one successful construction in each of the six case-by-family cells. This is a feasibility threshold, not statistical evidence for convergence.
operational_gates.stop_or_repair_protocol: If the gate fails, report missing cells and technical/information gaps, stop this pilot and design a separately versioned future unit; do not expand or replace slots here.
operational_gates.prose_only_outcome: Report a limited declared-choice pilot and its missing executable evidence; do not relabel it a generation comparison.
operational_gates.scientific_claim_gate: No count or threshold here establishes universal convergence, cross-model prior distributions, causal provider effects, superior clinical accuracy or uncertainty calibration.

checklist.item: two source-only payloads assembled and independently checked
12 contexts scheduled with counterbalanced case order
all initial responses preserved before repair
coding independent of provider identity where practicable
all code/spec and failure receipts frozen
operational go/stop decision and limitation statement
